entry.author: NZ Defence Force
entry.summary:
A New Zealand Army infantry platoon has wrapped up a demanding 90-day deployment alongside Republic of Korea and United States forces, sharpening combat readiness and proving they can operate seamlessly in a multinational force. 

Their deployment included invaluable training opportunities at the world-class Korea Combat Training Center, which culminated in a gruelling 96-hour tactical exercise. 

“By training alongside our partners in these sorts of environments, it ensures our soldiers are not only highly interoperable but at times interchangeable within a multinational force, which is vital in today’s strategic environment.” ~ Land Component Commander, Brigadier Jason Dyhrberg

Full story ➡️ nzdf.mil.nz/ROK-deployment
